sourceScope: Recorded whole-household food coverage days; not package-to-day or nutritional inference.
activation: New SessionInventorySeed values default to recordedHouseholdDays. Missing foodPolicy on decoded historical seeds preserves water-only behavior. Unknown policies reject.

rate.definition: One explicitly recorded coverage day per 1440 simulated minutes, while not relocated. No wall-clock draw.

preconditions: Confirmed access under the committed route/hazard state
Unrestricted stock or explicit scope covering every household member
accounting: Settle the host draw across accessible eligible physical records in stable ID order; remaining plus consumed equals original confirmed usable quantity in each record's day unit. Blocked/expired stock remains physically present and cannot contribute accessible coverage.
unknown: Missing amount, access, household scope or compatible day units prevents a confident aggregate duration. Missing evidence is not zero; confirmed zero remains zero.
boundaries: Stop at mandatory depletion and expiry boundaries; same-minute water/food depletion is deterministic. No implicit replenishment.
interpretation: This is a recorded-quantity exercise assumption. It does not establish dietary suitability, calories, safe storage, spoilage or food availability after relocation. The snapshot preserves an explicit storage/dietary uncertainty.
scoring: Hypothetical consumption never changes real inventory or preparation scores. Food challenges are advisory outside a separately approved scored stress envelope.
guidanceHorizon: The draft three-day criterion is limited; S64 distinguishes three-day evacuation and two-week home supplies. Depletion is not a medical harm deadline.
